criteria.requirement: Add Job.on_weekdays(*weekdays) for every(1).day(s) jobs, accepting nonempty integer weekdays 0..6 (Monday=0), deduplicating them and returning self. Integrate selection into _schedule_next_run in its configured timezone before existing UTC correction, preserving .at clock and strict-future scheduling. Revalidate eligibility if job attributes change; reject other intervals/units/start_day and invalid weekday values. Do not alter legacy .monday/.weeks or unconstrained daily schedules.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
